sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: We break down Qwen-RobotSuite, the Qwen team's three new embodied AI models. We cover RobotManip, a Vision-Language-Action model built on Qwen3.5-4B for manipulation. We cover RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model with a 60-layer MMDiT. We cover RobotNav, a navigation model built on Qwen3-VL across 2B, 4B, and 8B sizes. We walk through the architecture, data pipelines, and benchmark results for each. The post Meet Qwen-RobotSuite: Three Embodied AI Models for VLA Manipulation, Video World Modeling, and Navigation appeared first on MarkTechPost .
